fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. They hold him "…until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them." (Leviticus 24:12) Nobody rushes this one. No guessing, no voting, no "I feel like we should…" They wait, and then the LORD speaks to Moses. (Leviticus 24:13)

Yes, baker. The LORD says, "You are to have the same standard of law for the foreign resident and the native; for I am the LORD your God." (Leviticus 24:22) One LORD, one standard. No special rules for who walks in the door, and no fine print. I wish my old junk drawer had run that fair.
